changes: Property-name appends borrow string inputs. Common prim classification and root-name queries avoid component iteration; ASCII identifiers use byte checks with a Unicode fallback.

AbstractData::property_spec returns a stored property key and its spec type in one lookup. Data and CrateData support borrowed compound keys. Box and CowData forward the query, with overlay edits respected.
Property kinds are cached by composition revision and shared by canonical prototype queries. Authored-only enumeration reads the authored property set without a schema-definition query.
Property type-conflict detection retains the defining layer by reference and constructs the composed diagnostic path only for a conflict.
Internal numeric layer/stack dependency maps and owner sets use Fx hashing.

validation.dependency_checks: cargo deny --all-features --frozen check passed against a copied cached advisory database with the project policy unchanged except for the database directory.

instruction_profiles.measurement: Whole-process instructions through metadata traversal and stage destruction. No array phase. These profiles are separate from native timing series.

discarded_experiment.description: An intermediate candidate reused canonical paths for individual field reads and exposed property paths without returning their spec type. CowData initially used the allocating default lookup. Final code forwards property queries through CowData, returns path and type together, and keeps individual field reads on their original single-lookup path.

native_sampling.measurement: Starts at the first Stage::resolve_at call in the array phase and stops at the following Phase::end. Open, metadata traversal, and teardown are excluded. Sampling overhead is included in its elapsed time; it is not a timing benchmark.
